answer: An agent marketplace requires each identity to lock 100 tokens for 30 days before it can bid for work. An attacker can register agents named ember, knoll and haven, but each must post its own bond; creating 1,000 eligible identities ties up 100,000 tokens for a month. This does not prove that identities have different owners, but it makes a swarm costly to maintain and prevents instant, free replacement of banned agents.
